messages:
maria (CS): quick heads-up — did a 30m call with three pilot seats (Helix, Brightline, NovaRetail). pulled raw asks into a tiny spreadsheet and flagged 6 distinct asks. TL;DR: per-route cost visibility, embeddings staleness, faster onboarding tokens, and a small UX flow for fallback model selection.
linh (CS): can you drop the spreadsheet? want to add a couple of field notes from yesterday.
maria (CS): yep uploading now — CSV + short writeups. link: https://redwood.atlassian/feeds/CS-1719 (internal)
signal-bot: new artefact uploaded: CS-1719-feedback-deck.csv (uploaded by maria)
sam (PM): thanks. quick ask: can we bucket these into "revenue blocker" vs "quality of life"? i want to prep for next week's prioritization rubric.
ajules (Eng): quick question — embeddings staleness: is this a data pipeline lag (customer side) or model serving TTL?
maria (CS): pilot team says index refresh is daily and sometimes misses ingests; they want a way to force a partial reindex from the UI or API. not a server latency issue.
alesha (Product Ops): adding to rubric: impact on renewals, implement effort (eng), and enablement overhead. propose 3x3 matrix.
linh (CS): renewal risk score for Brightline is medium-high if we can't show per-route billing by next invoice cycle.
sam (PM): ok — immediate action items: 1) per-route cost toggle (quick UI enable) — exploratory spike; 2) add "force reindex" API endpoint for embeddings; 3) onboard checklist improvements (docs + 15m guided flow).
jules (Eng): spike for cost toggle — estimate 2 dev-days + 1 QA day if backend already surfaces per-route attribution. will confirm on Monday.
maria (CS): also a small ask: customers want a "preview" of fallback model outputs before enabling automatic fallback. helps them validate quality.
sam (PM): that ties to rollout controls. add to canary product card — low effort if we reuse existing preview modal.
alesha (Product Ops): i'll slot these into next triage meeting. can someone create a condensed one-pager for execs? one slide: asks, renewal risk, rough ETA.
linh (CS): i'll draft the one-pager and include verbatims. will ping @maria for quotes.
maria (CS): dropping 3 verbatim notes below to pull into the one-pager:
- "We need to see per-route spend to convince finance — current monthly bills hide cost per feature."
- "Our search answers degrade after a few days; we need manual refresh for urgent fixes."
- "Auto-fallback picked a lower-quality model once and confused users; a preview would avoid that."
sam (PM): perfect. can we also add suggested prioritization: 1) per-route billing visibility (high revenue impact), 2) force reindex API (medium-high), 3) preview modal for fallback (low-medium), 4) onboarding checklist improvements (low).
jules (Eng): noted. will follow up with a short tech plan for 1 & 2 by Tue EOD.
linh (CS): will send invite for triage 30m slot tomorrow 10:30am PT — invite includes the CSV and one-pager draft.
signal-bot: reminder set: triage meeting tomorrow 2024-04-16T17:30:00Z
alesha (Product Ops): emoji check — :thumbsup: if you agree w/ prioritization order or react with the change you want.
maria (CS): :thumbsup:
sam (PM): :thumbsup:
jules (Eng): :thinking_face: — prefer swapping 2 & 3 if force reindex touches infra we can't risk pre-commit. i'll confirm after tech plan.
linh (CS): noted. i'll include a brief "customer-level impact" section in the one-pager (renewal delta estimate).
maria (CS): great — thanks team. will close the loop after triage.
